expected_findings.evidence: Atlas Web is internet-facing and sits behind the enterprise WAF.
Every Atlas API endpoint enforces authentication and role-based authorisation.
The Reporting Store holds confidential data and is encrypted at rest.
Personal data is held only in the approved EU region.
The Settlement Connector reads via the Payments platform's published, versioned API rather than its database.
Atlas Web and Atlas API are deployed across three availability zones.
Human access is via enterprise single sign-on only.
A documented nightly backup with a stated 4-hour recovery objective exists for the Reporting Store.
All services emit centralised logs and health metrics to the enterprise monitoring platform.
